guard: Whole-stack shutdown retains both delivery credential keys until every required process stop succeeds.
why: Drive the unchanged shipped down and stopDelivery composition with real temporary filesystem credentials. Only the process-stop boundary is mocked. No process is started, signalled or probed.
The normal build precedes each run. Each afterRestore repeats the build and full fourteen-cell suite, so restored source and loaded artifacts must pass rather than leaving a compiled mutant behind.

Restoring early credential cleanup must fail DR01. DR03 independently observes credentials before the broker stop, but the suite stops at DR01 first; this fixture does not claim a separately executed DR03 kill.
Omitting successful whole-stack credential cleanup must fail DR07. Compiler, import or module-mock failures without the exact named assertion are wrong reds, not mutation kills.

This is source metadata only. Maintained admission, a green fourteen-cell baseline, both named kills and rebuilt restored green are unexecuted. No safety policy, test assertion or live suite is changed or concealed.
